// diagnostic

E3222

Inline C/C++ body cannot satisfy its declared scalar Jet ABI, or inline asm uses a non-integer/unsupported signature; native tool output stays hidden (D-FFI-INLINE1/ASM1, I2)

What

Inline C/C++ body cannot satisfy its declared scalar Jet ABI, or inline asm uses a non-integer/unsupported signature; native tool output stays hidden (D-FFI-INLINE1/ASM1, I2)

Why

The registered sema/build rule applies here

Fix

Make the inline body and signature use a supported scalar ABI.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3222: tests/ui/ffi_asm_float_signature.stderr.

Error [E3222]: `#FFI(asm)` has a signature its register binder can't represent
  --> tests/ui/ffi_asm_float_signature.jet:3:51
    |
  3 | #[Unsafe("register-only increment"), FFI(asm)] fn increment(value: Float) Float -> {
    |                                                   ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The audited assembly bridge uses general-purpose integer registers; floats and Bool need explicit conversion in Jet before the boundary
 Fix: Use Int or I8/I16/I32/I64/U8/U16/U32/U64 parameters and return values
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3222
